clue.text: Aspect of best service is being in personal contact

parts.note: a facet is one aspect or side of something
taken as written
an ace in tennis is a serve the opponent cannot touch, the best possible service

explanation.surface: A tennis coach praises the finest serve as a matter of personal touch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is not a link word here: it supplies its own letters between the two other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Meeting someone in the flesh, rather than by letter or phone, is to be together in person, directly confronting one another.

clue.text: Don't eat so quickly

definitions.meaning: to go without food, as at Lent or Ramadan

explanation.definitionFit: To abstain from food is the verb sense; moving at speed is the adverb sense of the same word.

clue.text: Shelled group of soldiers at front in accurate burst

indicators.note: the soldiers' leading letter is set inside the rearranged word
something burst is broken apart, so the letters of accurate fly into a new order
only the leading letter of soldiers is wanted

explanation.surface: A precise explosion goes off amid the leading troops of a military unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'burst' turns ACCURATE into CRUTACEA, and 'in' slips S, from 'soldiers at front', in after the U.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabs, lobsters and shrimps form the biological class of hard-shelled arthropods, a group defined by their armour.

clue.text: Novel work by Holbein

definitions.meaning: a late novel by Henry James
Hans Holbein the Younger's famous double portrait in the National Gallery, London

explanation.definitionFit: The same title names both a Henry James book and a celebrated 1533 painting with its distorted skull.

clue.text: Prevent foreign money raised being invested in coal substitute

indicators.note: to be invested in something is to be put inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: to foil a plan is to prevent it succeeding

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the leu is the currency of Romania

explanation.surface: Sanctions block overseas cash flowing into a replacement for coal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns the Romanian currency upwards to give UEL, and 'being invested in' sets it inside the word for prevent.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy oil burned in furnaces and boilers took over from coal as a fuel in many industries.

clue.text: Old fighter in Burma uses Indian language in court

indicators.note: the language is placed inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: Hindi is the main language of northern India

explanation.surface: A veteran of the Burma campaign speaks an Indian tongue before a tribunal.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chindits were Orde Wingate's long-range jungle units fighting the Japanese in Burma in the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chindit was a soldier of the Allied special force that operated behind Japanese lines in Burma.

clue.text: In hand, conceal prize

definitions.meaning: to hide something such as a card or coin in the hand, as a conjuror does

explanation.definitionFit: A conjuror's sleight of hand is to hide a card in the hand; a frond was the ancient victor's award, hence a prize.

clue.text: Leading schools have one

definitions.meaning: read as two words, every school has a head teacher

explanation.definitionFit: Being in front of rivals is to be in the lead; split in two, the word gives the head teacher every school has.

clue.text: One composer (not me) arranged another

indicators.note: arranged, like a musical piece, means the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: Giuseppe Verdi, the Italian opera composer

explanation.surface: A composer modestly excludes himself while setting the work of a colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: '(not me)' looks like an aside, but it is the fodder: 'arranged' turns NOT ME into MONTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudio Monteverdi, the early Baroque Italian who wrote Orfeo, is a second composer beside Verdi.

clue.text: Take pity on one grinding hamburger?

parts.note: to give quarter is to show mercy, so to quarter an enemy is to spare them
a pounder is something that pounds or grinds, like a pestle

explanation.surface: Feel sorry for someone stuck at a mill wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as an example: a quarter-pounder is one particular kind of burger.
explanation.definitionFit: A burger patty weighing a quarter of a pound is a well-known fast-food hamburger, given by example.

clue.text: Southern river is thoroughly wet

parts.note: the Ouse is the name of several English rivers

explanation.surface: A river in the south of England has soaked everything.
explanation.definitionFit: To drench or soak something completely is to make it wet right through, as with pickling brine.

clue.text: Film for everyone to see about an expert at the table

parts.note: an epic is a grand, large-scale film
U is the British film certificate for universal viewing, suitable for all
re means about or concerning
taken as written

explanation.surface: A family-friendly movie about a top chef or food critic.
explanation.definitionFit: A gourmet devoted to refined food and drink is a connoisseur of dining, a master of the table.

clue.text: Almost die beside two river crossings in battle

indicators.note: almost the whole word, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a die is a tool for stamping, so a stamp
a ford is a shallow place to wade across a river
a bridge carries a road over a river

explanation.surface: A soldier nearly perishes near a ford and a bridge in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' drops the P from STAMP; 'two river crossings' supplies both FORD and BRIDGE. Stamford Bridge is also the London ground of Chelsea football club.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1066 battle near York where Harold II defeated the Norwegian king Harald Hardrada just before Hastings.

clue.text: Scrabble player likes to elicit no successful response

definitions.meaning: picking a blank tile, the wildcard, from the Scrabble bag is a welcome stroke of luck
to get nowhere, finding nothing in a search or inquiry

explanation.definitionFit: Taking the wildcard tile from the bag delights a word-game player; idiomatically the phrase means failing to find anything.

clue.text: Island provides souvenir sweet to everyone

parts.note: rock is a hard stick of candy sold at British seaside resorts as a souvenir
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A seaside visitor brings back candy sticks for the whole family.
explanation.walkthrough: ROCKALL is a tiny uninhabited islet in the North Atlantic, west of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Rockall is a remote granite islet in the Atlantic, famous from the shipping forecast area named after it.

clue.text: Minute into really stiff drink, get the shakes

indicators.note: the abbreviation goes inside the drink word

parts.note: a treble is a triple measure of spirits, much stronger than a single

explanation.surface: A minute after downing a strong triple, someone starts shaking.
explanation.walkthrough: A treble is three measures of spirits in one glass; 'into' puts the minute inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To shake or quiver involuntarily, from fear, cold or drink, is to have the shakes.

clue.text: In city pub, a litre once drunk

parts.note: a bar is a pub or the counter in one

indicators.note: drunk suggests something reeling and disordered, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: In a city pub, someone has downed a litre at a single go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' shakes A, L and the word once into CELONA; 'In' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Barcelona is the Catalan capital and Spain's second city, on the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Intelligence about high-level cover-ups, person not to be named

indicators.note: about here means around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: wit means intelligence or sharpness of mind
hats cover the head, the highest part of the body

explanation.surface: Spies gather intelligence on top-level concealment, about an agent who must stay anonymous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover-ups' suggests scandal but means headgear; 'about' wraps the intelligence word around them.
explanation.definitionFit: A placeholder word used for someone or something whose name is forgotten or best left unsaid.

clue.text: No climbing into 1 dn at close of day

indicators.note: the turned word goes inside the other piece

parts.note: the answer to 1 down means firm or secure, as in held fast, a synonym of tight

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means reading upwards, so the word is reversed

explanation.surface: Refusal creeps into a fast that ends at nightfall.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 down is FAST, here in its 'firmly fixed' sense; 'climbing' turns No upwards to make ON, which 'into' places inside.
explanation.definitionFit: This evening, when the day closes, is what the word means as an adverb of time.

clue.text: Maybe took Lord's place to act as appeal judge

definitions.text: Maybe took Lord's place to act as appeal judge

parts.words: Maybe took Lord's place to act as appeal judge
parts.note: it reads like a judge in the House of Lords hearing appeals, but Lord's is the London cricket ground, where an official in a white coat decides appeals for wickets

explanation.definitionFit: The cricket official who rules on appeals for lbw and catches officiated, perhaps at Lord's.

clue.text: Release popular record among non-British collection

indicators.note: among means placed inside the other piece
without the B that stands for British

parts.note: a bunch is a collection of things
a hit is a popular record

explanation.surface: A best-selling record is released into a crowd of foreign listeners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'non-British' strips the B from the collection word to leave UNCH, and 'among' puts the record inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten a horse or a trailer from what it is attached to is to set it free.

clue.text: Getting on with publishing firms that offer accommodation

parts.note: boarding a bus or ship is getting on it
publishers are known as publishing houses

explanation.surface: Climbing aboard alongside publishers who provide lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is elliptical: '(places) that offer accommodation', which these lodging houses are.
explanation.definitionFit: Lodging establishments where guests pay for a room and meals are places that provide accommodation.

clue.text: Demand we found rising, not level

parts.note: to ask is to demand or request

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means reading upwards, so the word turns round

explanation.surface: We protest that the ground we discovered slopes upward and is uneven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns WE into EW; 'found' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something crooked or awry is out of line, not straight or level.

clue.text: Some girls very taken by old governor

indicators.note: taken by means held inside the other piece

parts.note: a bey was a governor of a province in the Ottoman Empire

explanation.surface: Several young women are greatly charmed by an elderly governor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken by' puts V inside BEY, after the B.
explanation.definitionFit: A group or flock, traditionally of larks, quails or girls, is the collective noun for a company.

clue.text: Wicket is in state appropriate for inventive old spinner

indicators.note: the letter is placed inside the run of the other two pieces

parts.note: ARK is an abbreviation for Arkansas, a US state
right means appropriate or fitting
W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: A cricket pitch in good shape suits a crafty veteran slow bowler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinner' suggests a cricket bowler, but Richard Arkwright invented the water frame for spinning cotton; 'is in' puts the wicket between the state and appropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Arkwright, the 18th-century inventor of the water-powered spinning frame, was a pioneering cotton spinner.

clue.text: Doctor's note inhibiting working for him?

indicators.note: inhibiting means holding in, so the outer pieces restrain the inner one

parts.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor
E is a musical note
on means working, as a machine that is switched on

explanation.surface: A sick note stops someone from going to work.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads with the clue: a male bee does no work, as if signed off sick; 'inhibiting' holds working inside the doctor and note.
explanation.definitionFit: The male honeybee does no work in the hive, so a doctor's note excusing labour seems made for him.

clue.text: Said to be vital little bird

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the words are heard rather than read

parts.note: key means vital and wee means little, together making the sound

explanation.surface: A tiny bird is described as essential.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless nocturnal kiwi is New Zealand's national bird.

clue.text: Upset tea-tray he'd prepared

indicators.note: an upset tray spills, so the letters fall into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: He knocked over the tea-tray he had carefully set out.
explanation.definitionFit: Ready for immediate use, poised for action, as a weapon held in position.
